title: SessionDiffFile

path.description: Relative to the workspace when the file is inside it, else as the tool named it.

diff.description: A unified diff of the changes, one hunk per change in order. A hunk's line numbers are the file's when the tool's output carried its patch, else counted from the edited text.

runId.description: A run's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when the run starts or is adopted.

tool.description: The tool's name as the provider gave it: Edit, MultiEdit, Write, NotebookEdit.

status.description: How a tool call ended: ok, error, or cancelled.

items.description: One tool call that changed a file: its run, call, tool and how it ended.

description: A file the session's runs changed: its path, the diff and the tool calls behind it.
